# The signer column: node judgments

[M] Lane rs-147, assigned Codex gpt-6-astra ultrafast, profile openai-2; GitHub Calgooon. Runtime variant and tier are not independently exposed.

[D] Synthetic outpoints are judged by `verifyscript` with the corpus prevouts; no coins are funded and nothing is submitted or broadcast. Each signed engine transaction and the self-check's hand-signed control are judged under both derived words. Both columns use the oracle's zeroed policy caps (consensus limits); relay means the relay flag word, not mempool admission or default policy limits. Locktime/finality and fees are outside this script judgment. `stopOnFirstInvalid=false` judges every input. A trace is one input in one column; site digests are compared separately, once per signed method. The node exposes input verdicts, not per-site execution verdicts. Refusal counts count each transaction once per class; classes can overlap when different inputs fail for different reasons. The refused union is signed minus valid for each column.

[M] `signer self-consistency: GREEN [X] (241 api-scriptcode rows, 456 site digests equal, 0 unequal) engine=bsv-rs`. This compares two callers of the same library digest primitives; it is a self-consistency check. Every signed result is separately judged by the node.

[SRC] bsv-rs 0.5.0 `src/script/template.rs:85-99` selects the source locking script and calls the BIP143-only function `src/primitives/bsv/sighash.rs:941-944`. Its dispatched function at `:962-983` selects the original digest for Chronicle and returns constant one for original SINGLE beyond outputs. The node selects scriptCode at bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 `6504a3af` `src/script/interpreter.cpp:1471-1481`, dispatches at `:2112-2124` and returns original SINGLE constant one at `:2086-2100`. [SRC] bsv-rs 0.5.0 `src/primitives/bsv/sighash.rs:941-944` builds the BIP143 preimage (`:384`, `SighashCache::preimage` `:546-570`) whose hashOutputs is 32 zero bytes for SINGLE beyond outputs (`SighashCache::hash_outputs` `:534-536`), whatever the CHRONICLE bit; the node returns constant one for the same scope (`interpreter.cpp:2086-2100`, `:2112-2124`).

[SRC] The public `unlock` paths are bsv-rs 0.5.0 `src/script/templates/p2pkh.rs:151-175`, `src/script/templates/p2pk.rs:67-86` and `src/script/templates/multisig.rs:161-187`. The options at `src/script/template.rs:112-120` cannot express Chronicle or omit FORKID, so those template rows are unsigned. Transaction signing at `src/transaction/transaction.rs:1430-1459` uses the same context.

[D] Class precedence is lock-only, constant-one, then Chronicle BIP143. In-unlock Chronicle rows can have both scriptCode and dispatch differences; the lock-only count is not proof that scriptCode is the sole cause. The Chronicle BIP143 marker requires scriptCode equal to the control and an exact BIP143 preimage/digest. Control refusals are separate classes: SIG_PUSHONLY (`interpreter.cpp:2321-2334`), ILLEGAL_CHRONICLE (`:296-303`) and MUST_USE_FORKID (`:296-306`) at the same node pin; they are not signer disagreements.

## Audit and comparison

[M] Run source `f819efe0`, based on `origin/main` at `dba6c0ae`; lane rs-147, assigned Codex gpt-6-astra ultrafast, local profile openai-2, GitHub account Calgooon. All commands completed in the foreground. The measured run completed in 9.01 seconds with a 3,600-second timeout. The independent crate-source audit found all nine inspected registry files byte-equal to bsv-rs commit `d06ea0dd12afba8f1a5ced9daf7faa61ba97ea69` at version 0.5.0.

[M] The go-sdk and ts-sdk columns equal the #145 piece 3 record (`20261016-203024-s3-145d-signer-column-s3.md`) for all counts, per-row results, digests, SINGLE decisions, words and verdict lines. Source provenance, the additional explicit-scriptCode counters, and additional witnesses for control-refusal classes are recorded separately. No SDK measurement moved. [X] The two JSON records are retained because they are not byte-identical to #145: each adds the explicit-scriptCode counters and control-refusal witnesses, plus this run's source provenance. The measured per-row results, count tables, digests, SINGLE decisions and flag words match #145.

[M] bsv-rs `api-default` has 144 refused transactions: 44 intentional control refusals and 100 transactions differing from a valid control. The latter comprise 40 transactions in `sighash.scriptcode.in-unlock.lock-only`, 56 in `sighash.chronicle.bip143`, and seven in `sighash.single.out-of-range.one`. Three transactions occur in both Chronicle BIP143 and SINGLE classes because their inputs have different failures: `signer-p2pkh-00040`, `signer-version-00031`, and `signer-version-00032`. The input/column disagreement counts are respectively 108, 122 and 14. GREEN denotes complete classification.

[M] All 97 transactions signed through public templates were valid in both columns. Of the 144 unsigned template rows, 81 have no in-unlock template and 63 request a scope that the template options cannot express (multisig 17, p2pk 19, p2pkh 17, version 10; 62 carry the CHRONICLE bit, one is the 0x03 no-FORKID sentinel). Both API methods sign every one of the 241 rows. The explicit method's 197 valid transactions and 44 intentional refusals match the control under both words, with all 456 site digests equal. Its seven original SINGLE out-of-range transactions are accepted (14 input/column decisions); the default API's counterparts are refused. The 0x03 encoding sentinel is refused as MUST_USE_FORKID by both methods and controls and does not decide signature-hash correctness.

[M] Every recorded source hash matches the measured commit. Replaying the adapter reproduces all 723 transaction IDs or unsigned reasons. Every witness transaction ID was recomputed from its hex, every method covers 241 rows, and all count tables reconcile with the per-input node verdicts. The node was reaped, its run directory removed, and `pgrep -fl bitcoind` confirmed no lane instance remained; other instances were untouched.
